request: Set the Normal style to 6 pt after with single line spacing
summary: The Normal paragraph style (and every style based on it, unless it sets its own value) gets 6 pt space after and single line spacing; paragraphs with their own direct spacing keep it and are flagged.
assumptions: the change is made in the style definition, not on the paragraphs: every paragraph of the style follows unless it sets its own spacing
6 pt after is 120 twips; single spacing is line 240 with the auto rule
style definitions are never tracked (Word does not track them either)
